cg_phase.pool_membership_scope: Real columns accepted by frozen CG before cutoff, plus original singleton seeds; selected integer paths independently replayed after stopping; all-pool path witnesses are not claimed
cg_phase.cutoff_policy: Unprocessed candidates from a pricing call crossing the phase deadline are discarded; the complete call is charged to the total pipeline budget

restricted_mip.bound_scope: Restricted integer pool only; never a full-family lower bound

selected_paths.scope: Physical DP-path or verified initial-singleton witnesses; aggregate master and pricing certificates checked separately.
